name: DP360 CRM
headline: Moving a CRM used by 2,000+ dealerships off Angular 1, with CI/CD and real-time messaging
overview: Dealership Performance 360 CRM is a lead management and sales CRM for powersports, marine, RV, trailer, automotive and agriculture retailers across the US, Canada and the UK. Since 2019 Techlio has been a core engineering team on it: modernizing the legacy front end, building SMS and telephony infrastructure and keeping a 300+ partner integration ecosystem running.

challenges.title: Legacy AngularJS front end
challenges.text: Angular 1 made screens slow, new features risky and the codebase harder to maintain as the dealer base grew.

challenges.title: High-volume communications
challenges.text: Thousands of dealerships send texts and calls daily, each needing near real-time delivery, routing and compliance.

challenges.title: Lead response speed
challenges.text: Leads must reach the right salesperson fast or the sale goes to a quicker competitor.

challenges.title: Integration-heavy ecosystem
challenges.text: With 300+ OEMs, DMS providers, lead portals and website vendors connected, any change can break a dealer's data flow.

solutions.title: Angular 17 revamp
solutions.text: Performance bottlenecks profiled and most modules rebuilt from Angular 1 to Angular 17, keeping backward compatibility and data integrity.

solutions.title: SMS and telephony platform
solutions.text: Webhook-driven texting and calling on Twilio and Telnyx with call routing, recordings, tracking and real-time dealer alerts.

solutions.title: Lead routing and automation
solutions.text: Lead routing, appointment reminders and engagement workflows on AWS SQS and Lambda for reliable asynchronous processing.

solutions.title: Scalable infrastructure and CI/CD
solutions.text: Services containerized with Docker, deployments automated with GitHub Actions, and load-balanced EC2 monitored with CloudWatch.

results: 2,000+ dealerships run their daily sales process on DP360
300+ OEM, DMS, portal and website integrations supported
Core modules moved from Angular 1 to Angular 17
Near real-time SMS and calling through Twilio and Telnyx
architecture: An Angular 17 front end runs over CakePHP and Node.js services on MySQL, hosted on AWS with Docker and GitHub Actions for CI/CD, and Twilio and Telnyx for SMS and telephony. n8n, Scikit-learn and ServiceNow support workflow automation, data analysis and service workflows around the CRM.
